Bihar Vidhan Parishad: bihar vidhanasbha bharti prakiya men bara badlav!| CM Samrat| Breaking |Bihar News
Bihar vidhanasbha ki koee bhi bahali ab BPSC ya BSSC se karayi jaegi...mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ne iske nirdesh die hain...sutron ki manen to vidhan parishad ke lie bahali ke ke niymon men bhi badlav kiye jane ka aagrah vidhan parishad ke sabhapti se kiya gaya hai...halanki donon sadnon ke sachivalyon ki or se is prastav par antim muhar aur aadhikarik adhisuchna jari hona abhi baki hai.
Bihar aur jharkhand ke taza khabron ke lie dekhte rahie News18 Bihar/Jharkhand
